name: splitrun_2plus3
description: The '2+3' splitrun (scripted, found from first principles). Before each turn the actor holds 2 pieces (12,333 + 6,167) and the partner 3 (9,250 + 6,167 + 3,083). The actor presses ONE single split: its big piece's half eats the partner's 3,083 backpiece, and its small piece's half flies into the partner's 9,250 and is eaten. The result is the exact mirror image, so the partner does the same back 2.5 s later. 24 turns shown; tested clean for 400 turns (16.5 min), centre drift < 200 units.
